faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (SMP Kolkata) for filling up vacant positions under their administrative control.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in the notification?
faq.answer: The post advertised in this notification is Dy Materials Manager Gr-I under the materials management and engineering department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Dy Materials Manager Gr-I?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Dy Materials Manager Gr-I post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for SMP Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 05 November 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or equivalent in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering along with 5 years of relevant executive experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Dy Materials Manager Gr-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years, calculated as on the crucial eligibility date specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary in the pay scale of Rs. 50,000 - 1,60,000/- as per port authority guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The Secretary, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Kolkata, 15, Strand Road, Kolkata-700001 via post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form annexure directly from the official website www.smportkolkata.shipping.gov.in.
